issues.description: Constructor mismatch: the Course initializer's parameter labels and order differ between artifacts. The problem statement/example and the template declare and expect an initializer with signature init(name: String, instructor: String, ratings: [Int]) (example usage: Course(name: "My Course", instructor: "My Instructor", ratings: [])). In the solution implementation the initializer is declared as init(instructor: String, name: String, ratings: [Int]) (the external labels are 'instructor' then 'name'), while the solution's Client still constructs Course using the labels name: then instructor:. This inconsistency between the intended signature (name:, instructor:) and the solution's implementation signature is confusing for students and deviates from the template/problem expectation.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the Course initializer consistent across artifacts. Prefer changing the solution implementation to declare the initializer as init(name: String, instructor: String, ratings: [Int]) so it matches the problem statement and the template. Alternatively, if keeping the solution's parameter order, update the template and problem example (and all call sites) to use the same external parameter labels (instructor: then name:), but aligning to name:, instructor: is recommended to avoid confusing learners.
